# mistershell_configure_template (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell configure template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_configure_template" "example" {
  name             = "device-hostname"
  body             = "hostname {{ vars.hostname }}"
  variables_schema = [{ name = "hostname", type = "string", required = true }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `body` (String) Body.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `renderer` (String) Renderer.
- `variables_schema` (Dynamic) Variables schema. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_configure_template.example 123
```
